title: H8: worker packets carry a version hash, base sha and source provenance and never drop an acceptance criterion; bus_events takes role and task filters
spec:
Build on goal/T-0353. Handover sections 6 and 7. Evidence (scout T-0355): spawn.packet has no hash/version/provenance field; when the packet exceeds its cap the acceptance list is summarized to 5 bullets plus "N more in task" (G2 fix round 2), which the handover forbids (objective, acceptance and constraints must never be dropped); bus.events(since, limit) has no role or task filter, so callers read every event.
1. spawn.packet: the rendered packet starts with one header line "packet v<hash12> base <sha12> sources pool.toml@<policy_version> gotchas@<gotchas sha12>" where hash12 is sha256 of the packet body (excluding the header), the base sha is the worktree base commit already computed, policy_version is bus.policy_version() if H1 has landed else a sha of pool.toml (import guarded), and the gotchas sha is over the matched gotcha lines. Provide spawn.packet_meta(task, worktree) returning the same values as a dict for the run record.
2. Truncation order change: acceptance is never shortened. When the packet exceeds the cap, drop sections in this order until it fits: evidence pointers, decisions, gotchas, symbols, relevant tests, then trim the objective's discovery text; acceptance, base, write scope, read scope, constraints and the verification command always stay complete even if the packet ends above the cap, and the header then adds "over cap by <n> chars: acceptance kept whole".
3. bus.events(since, limit, role=None, task_ids=None): filters applied after seq ordering, seq values unchanged, so a filtered read still advances the same cursor and no event is lost or renumbered; bus_mcp bus_events exposes the two optional parameters and its reply includes next_since (last seq seen, filtered or not) and truncated: true when limit was hit.
Tests: tests/test_spawn.py::test_packet_header_has_hash_base_and_sources, ::test_packet_hash_changes_when_body_changes, ::test_packet_over_cap_keeps_every_acceptance_criterion (a 60-criterion acceptance survives whole; discovery sections drop first); tests/test_bus.py::test_events_role_filter_keeps_seq_and_cursor, ::test_events_truncated_flag_and_next_since. Keep every existing test green (adjust the G2 test that expected the 5-bullet summary); .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: no packet rendering path shortens the acceptance list (grep for the 'more in task' summary shows it removed)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
